notConfiguredTitle: Personal Telegram is not set up on this NIVO yet
notConfiguredBody: The administrator needs to add TELEGRAM_API_ID and TELEGRAM_API_HASH (from my.telegram.org) to the server settings first.
nameHint: For example: Sales account of Lan.
consent1: NIVO reads only the chats you pick in the next steps.
consent2: NIVO never sends messages, never deletes anything and never marks chats as read.
consent3: Anyone holding this session could read the account, so NIVO keeps it encrypted. Disconnecting deletes it. You can also end it yourself in Telegram, Settings, Devices.
phoneHint: With country code, for example +84912345678. A number starting with 0 is read as Vietnamese.
codeSentApp: Telegram sent a code to the Telegram app on your other devices.
codeSentSms: Telegram sent a code by text message.
codeHint: The code stays valid for a few minutes. NIVO does not store it.
passwordTitle: Two-step verification is on for this account
passwordHint: Used once to sign in. NIVO does not store it.
chatsHint: Tick up to {max} chats. Only these are read and stored.
scheduleLabel: How often to read new messages
scheduleHint: Each run reads at most 200 new messages per chat.
agentTitle: Agents that may read these messages
